name: The Tie Fundraising and M&A
description:
The Tie Fundraising and M&A connector gives you direct access to the industry's most comprehensive crypto fundraising dataset: over 12,000 funding rounds, 8,000 investors, and 5,300 companies, spanning every major crypto deal since 2005.
 
This is the same data that powers fundraising intelligence on The Tie Terminal, now queryable in plain language. Ask specific questions and get structured answers in seconds:
 
• Which VCs led the most rounds in AI crypto in 2025?
• Show me all ZK protocol fundraises above $10M
• Which investors backed both AI and DeFi projects in the last 12 months?
• List every fundraise in the stablecoin sector since January 2025

The dataset links companies to their associated tokens and sectors, so you can move from a company to its coin to its category in a single query.

_published_faq.name: How do I add The Tie Fundraising and M&A to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add The Tie Fundraising and M&A to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.api-thetie.io/fundraising-ma. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the The Tie Fundraising and M&A MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Tie Fundraising and M&A provides these MCP tools: get_fundraising_investors, get_fundraising_rounds, get_ma_deals, and get_metadata.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to The Tie Fundraising and M&A?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to The Tie Fundraising and M&A in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does The Tie Fundraising and M&A MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Tie Fundraising and M&A requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops The Tie Fundraising and M&A?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Tie Fundraising and M&A is developed by The Tie. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
